name: New York City
note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the 1865 shoreline, the squares and church footprints carry the fit; the 1811 and 1865 sheets span the island beyond the 2000 m town box, so those fits are likely to end review items (the Venice precedent, docs/lead_artists.md)

name: Washington, D.C.
note: aerial-photograph ground (no open LiDAR over the built-up city: bare-earth LiDAR erases the streets); the street grid, the diagonal avenues, the Potomac shoreline and the squares carry the fit; the 1865 defences ring spans ~35 km beyond the 2000 m town box, so that fit is likely to end a review item (the Venice precedent, docs/lead_artists.md); the ring's forts are candidate kind-'fort' sites and the catalog already has the individuals (Fort Bayard Q3077774, Fort DeRussy Q5471024, Fort Totten Q18150335, Fort Marcy Q61784495, Fort Foote Q14691922, all part_of Q5124610 'Civil War defenses of Washington, D.C.' - data/catalog/sites.jsonl)
